summary: Enhance your understanding of global finance with our International Monetary Policy Coordination Training Course. Join us to master effective policy strategies.
lede: International monetary policy coordination aligns policy analysis and decisions when shocks transmit across markets. For professionals supporting monetary policy decisions and executive reporting, the training covers assessing inflation and policy-rate gaps, analyzing spillovers and exchange-rate pressures, comparing options through shock scenarios, and preparing coordinated policy memos and communication briefs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support monetary policy decisions, cross-border coordination, and executive reporting in central banking and related institutions.
modules: Coordinating Interest Rate and Liquidity Actions
Scenario Planning and Policy Transmission Analysis
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and enough familiarity to build tables, charts, and simple formulas. If available, bring anonymized policy notes, recent central bank statements, inflation reports, or public macro dashboards for workshop use. Participants should be prepared to work with case materials, scenario templates, and executive briefing formats.
